summary:
Held 0 of today's 10 biggest UK/EU movers.

• 6 upside misses — RHM.DE +6%, UMG.AS +4%, EL.PA +4%, BAB.L +4%, BMW.DE +4%. These cleared the universe screen but no strategy picked them up; the morning brief either filtered them on a catalyst/RSI/earnings rule or had nothing positive to trigger an entry.

• 4 downside moves (BESI.AS -5%, SMT.L -3%, URW.PA -2%, AZN.L -2%) are unreachable on a long-only basket — no mechanism to express a short or pair-trade.

• Most instructive miss: RHM.DE (+6.26%) — No company-specific news found for 10-19. Likely a European defence-sector rally on Ukraine/US-support doubts and Morgan Stanley's call for year-end contract awards, extending a week of gains. Why we passed: Outside any active strategy's universe: RHM.DE is a large-cap German (Xetra) defence name that no strategy lists. The move was also a sector-driven continuation after a ~17% weekly run, which RSI or extension filters would likely have rejected.
